user.title: Tianjin Water
user.description: Use the SESSION from a successful query for your own water account. A full Cookie header is accepted. The account must remain linked to that WeChat user. Polling does not guarantee session renewal.

reauth_confirm.title: Tianjin Water
reauth_confirm.description: Polling is paused. Provide a new SESSION for the same billing account. A known expired SESSION will not be retried.

reconfigure.title: Tianjin Water
reconfigure.description: Provide a working SESSION. Successful validation resumes polling for the same account. Resolve any account unlinking or server problem first.

error.invalid_account: The billing account must contain only digits.
error.invalid_session: Invalid SESSION format. Copy the Cookie from a successful query.
error.invalid_user_agent: The User-Agent is too long or contains invalid characters.
error.invalid_auth: Authentication was rejected. Sign in again and obtain a new SESSION.
error.cannot_connect: Cannot connect to the water service. Try again later.
error.unexpected_response: The service returned an unexpected response. Expiry is unconfirmed. Check the account remains linked to the original WeChat user and the website works.
error.same_expired_session: This SESSION was already rejected. Provide a new SESSION.

abort.already_configured: This billing account is already configured.

state.retrying: Connection failed, waiting for next poll

invalid_auth.message: Authentication was rejected. Sign in again and obtain a new SESSION.

cannot_connect.message: Cannot connect to the water service. Try again later.

polling_stopped.message: Polling is stopped. Review diagnostics and use Reconfigure to resume.

polling_stopped.title: Tianjin Water polling stopped
polling_stopped.description: Reason: {reason}. Verify the billing account is still linked to the original WeChat user and the website works. Then use Reconfigure with a working SESSION. Restarting does not resume polling.
